biography:
== Biography ==
Thomas McElligott was born in Ireland about 1844, the son of Patrick McElligott and Catharine Moore.<ref name="reg1868">"Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927", database with images, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:FHGX-R4D : accessed 18 November 2026), Thomas McElligott and Mary Sullivan, married 7 Nov 1868, Charlestown; Charlestown Marriage Records 1843-1874, entry 255 (image 509 of 686). Groom 24, laborer, born Ireland, parents Patrick McElligott and Catharine Moore; bride 25, born Ireland, parents James Sullivan and Joanna Connors; married by Rev. George A. Hamilton, Charlestown.</ref><ref name="tmmarr1868">"Massachusetts, U.S., Marriage Records, 1840-1915", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/2511/records/7907390 and https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/2511/records/17907390 : accessed 17 November 2026), Thomas Mc Elligott, 24, born Ireland, son of Patrick and Catharine, and Mary Sullivan, 25, born Ireland, daughter of James and Joanna, married 7 Nov 1868, Charlestown.</ref><ref name="tmmarr1881">"Massachusetts, U.S., Marriage Records, 1840-1915", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/2511/records/2575484 : accessed 17 November 2026), Thomas McElligott, 37, laborer, born Ireland, parents Patrick and Katharine, 2nd marriage, and Hannah Noyes [as indexed], 37, born Ireland, parents James and Hannah, married 11 Oct 1881, Boston.</ref>

On 7 November 1868 he married Mary Sullivan, daughter of James and Joanna Sullivan, at Charlestown, Massachusetts.<ref name="tmmarr1868" /><ref name="tmchurch1868">"Massachusetts, U.S., Boston Archdiocese Roman Catholic Sacramental Records, 1789-1920", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/61585/records/232083 : accessed 17 November 2026), Thomas McElligot and Mary Sullivan, marriage 7 Nov 1868, Charlestown; vol. 48603, p. 106a.</ref> In 1870 they lived in Charlestown's Ward 1, where Thomas worked as a laborer.<ref name="census1870">"1870 United States Federal Census", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/7163/records/26578808 : accessed 17 November 2026), Thomas Mcellgott household, Charlestown Ward 1, Middlesex, Massachusetts, dwelling 1371; NARA M593, roll 625, p. 124B. Thomas 28, laborer, born Ireland; Mary 26; Patrick 5/12.</ref>

Their children, all baptised in Charlestown, were:
* Patrick, born 23 March 1870; died 30 August 1870.<ref name="patbapt">"Massachusetts, U.S., Boston Archdiocese Roman Catholic Sacramental Records, 1789-1920", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/61585/records/220939 : accessed 17 November 2026), Patrick McElligott, baptised 25 Mar 1870, Charlestown; father Thomas McElligott, mother Mary Sullivan; vol. 48609, p. 27.</ref><ref name="patdeath">"Massachusetts, U.S., Death Records, 1841-1915", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/2101/records/6517719 : accessed 17 November 2026), Patrick McAlligott, died 30 Aug 1870, Charlestown, infant; father Thomas McAlligott, mother Mary.</ref>
* Mary Ellen, baptised 18 August 1873; died 27 October 1889 in Boston, aged 16.<ref name="mebapt">"Massachusetts, U.S., Boston Archdiocese Roman Catholic Sacramental Records, 1789-1920", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/61585/records/221193 : accessed 17 November 2026), Mary Ellen McElligot, baptised 18 Aug 1873, Charlestown; father Thomas McElligot, mother Mary Sullivan; vol. 48609, p. 110.</ref><ref name="medeath">"Massachusetts, U.S., Death Records, 1841-1915", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/2101/records/1334663 : accessed 17 November 2026), Mary E McElligott, died 27 Oct 1889, Boston, age 16, born Charlestown; father Thomas, mother Mary.</ref>
* Catherine, baptised 21 January 1875.<ref name="cathbapt">"Massachusetts, U.S., Boston Archdiocese Roman Catholic Sacramental Records, 1789-1920", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/61585/records/297706 : accessed 17 November 2026), Catharinam [Catherine] McElligot, baptised 21 Jan 1875, Charlestown; father Thomae, mother Mariae.</ref>
* James Thomas, born 6 January 1877; married Mary Delores Carroll in 1904<ref name="jtmmarr">"Massachusetts, Town Clerk, Vital and Town Records, 1626-2001", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:FHKG-66Z : accessed 17 November 2026), James Thomas McElligott and Mary Delores Carroll, married 10 Oct 1904, Watertown, Middlesex, Massachusetts; groom born 1877, parents Thomas McElligott and Mary Sullivan; bride's parents James Carroll and Mary Hunt.</ref> and died 12 May 1924 in Boston.<ref name="jtmbirth">"Massachusetts, U.S., Town and Vital Records, 1620-1988", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/2495/records/47744464 : accessed 17 November 2026), James McElligott, born 6 Jan 1877, Boston; father Thomas [indexed "Thoams"], mother Mary Sullivan.</ref><ref name="jtmbapt">"Massachusetts, U.S., Boston Archdiocese Roman Catholic Sacramental Records, 1789-1920", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/61585/records/221418 : accessed 17 November 2026), Jacobum [James] McAlligott, born 6 Jan, baptised 7 Jan 1877, Charlestown; father Thoma McAlligott, mother Maria Sullivan; Boston Archdiocese Sacramental Records vol. 48609, p. 200.</ref><ref name="jtmdeath">"Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:6ZD7-X1YD : accessed 17 November 2026), James T McElligott, died 12 May 1924, Boston, Suffolk, Massachusetts; born 1877, Charlestown, Boston; parents Thomas McElligott and Mary Sullivan; spouse Mary Carroll McElligott.</ref>
* Margaret, baptised 21 April 1879; died 26 April 1879.<ref name="margbapt">"Massachusetts, U.S., Boston Archdiocese Roman Catholic Sacramental Records, 1789-1920", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/61585/records/266624 : accessed 17 November 2026), Margaritam [Margaret] McElligot, baptised 21 Apr 1879, Charlestown; father Thoma, mother Maria.</ref><ref name="margdeath">"Massachusetts, U.S., Death Records, 1841-1915", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/2101/records/3204714 : accessed 17 November 2026), Margaret McElligot, died 26 Apr 1879, Boston, infant; father Thomas, mother Mary.</ref>

Mary died in Boston on 17 May 1879, aged 34.<ref name="marysdeath">"Massachusetts, U.S., Death Records, 1841-1915", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/2101/records/3204834 : accessed 17 November 2026), Mary McAligott, died 17 May 1879, Boston; married, 34, wife of Thomas, born Ireland; father James, mother Joanna; Boston deaths 1879, p. 112, entry 60.</ref> On 11 October 1881, in Boston, Thomas married secondly Hannah (Anna) Nash, who was also born in Ireland.<ref name="tmmarr1881" /><ref name="cathmarr1881">"Massachusetts, U.S., Boston Archdiocese Roman Catholic Sacramental Records, 1789-1920", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/61585/records/171515 : accessed 18 November 2026), Thomas McElligott and Anna Nash, marriage 11 Oct 1881, Boston; vol. 48425, pp. 108-109.</ref> The civil register spells her surname so that it was indexed as "Noyes"; the Catholic register has Nash.

=== Research Notes ===
* His parents' names, Patrick and Catharine (Katharine), appear on both of his marriage records, which is what identifies the 1868 and 1881 grooms as the same man.
* '''Siblings.''' Three McElligotts who died in Boston named Catherine Moore as their mother and are almost certainly his siblings. Mary (about 1831 - 10 August 1901), single;<ref name="mary1901">"Massachusetts, U.S., Death Records, 1841-1915", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/2101/records/1851432 : accessed 17 November 2026), Mary McElligott, died 10 Aug 1901, Boston; single, 70, born Ireland; father Patrick McElligott, mother Catherine Moore.</ref> Margaret (about 1838 - 7 August 1918), single, a retired cook;<ref name="mar1918">"Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927", database with images, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:23RV-2Z1 : accessed 18 November 2026), Margaret McElligott, died 7 Aug 1918, Boston, certificate 7960, p. 87; single, 80, retired cook, born Ireland; father John McElligott, mother Catherine Moore; burial Holy Cross, Malden.</ref> and Patrick (March 1846 - 16 June 1917), a shoemaker, who married Frances Edwards in Boston in 1876 and whose own marriage names his parents as Patrick and Catharine.<ref name="patmarr1876">"Massachusetts, U.S., Marriage Records, 1840-1915", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/2511/records/5994722 : accessed 18 November 2026), Patrick Mc Elligott, 30, born Ireland, son of Patrick and Catharine Mc Elligott, married Frances Edwards, 14 May 1876, Boston.</ref><ref name="pat1917">"Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927", database with images, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:23RV-CMR : accessed 18 November 2026), Patrick McElligott, died 16 Jun 1917, Boston, certificate 6495, p. 162; widowed, 71 (born March 1846), retired shoemaker, born Ireland; father John McElligott, mother Catherine Moore; burial Holy Cross, Malden.</ref> In 1900 Mary lodged across Harrison Avenue from Patrick.<ref name="census1900pat">"1900 United States Federal Census", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/7602/records/75388057 and https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/7602/records/75388109 : accessed 18 November 2026), Boston Ward 9, Suffolk, Massachusetts, ED 1288, sheet 10: Patrick M"Elligott, 53, born Mar 1847 Ireland, immigrated 1865, boot and shoe maker, 637 Harrison Avenue; and Mary McElligon [McElligott], 67, born Mar 1833 Ireland, immigrated 1850, widowed, lodger at 646 Harrison Avenue.</ref> Patrick and Margaret were buried at Holy Cross Cemetery, Malden, and Mary was also buried in Malden. The 1917 and 1918 death records give the father's name as John, but the earlier records (Thomas's 1868 and 1881 marriages, Patrick's 1876 marriage and Mary's 1901 death) all say Patrick.
* '''Death (probable).''' Hannah McElligott, born Nash, "wife of Thomas McElligott", died in Boston on 13 July 1900.<ref name="hannah1900">"Massachusetts, U.S., Death Records, 1841-1915", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/2101/records/2184685 : accessed 18 November 2026), Hannah McElligott, maiden name Nash, wife of Thomas McElligott, died 13 Jul 1900, Boston, aged 50; born Ireland; parents Edmund Nash and Mary Ganty(?); burial Malden.</ref> A Thomas McElligott, aged 58, born in Ireland, a fireman, died in Boston on 15 July 1902 and was buried at Holy Cross, Malden, where his brother Patrick and sister Margaret were later buried.<ref name="tm1902">"Massachusetts, U.S., Death Records, 1841-1915", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/2101/records/1789901 : accessed 18 November 2026), Thomas McElligott, died 15 Jul 1902, Boston, aged 58; born Ireland; fireman; 4 Mason St, died Carney Hospital; burial Holy Cross, Malden; parents given as Thomas McElligott and Mary Gibbons.</ref> His death record names his parents as Thomas McElligott and Mary Gibbons, probably an informant's error (his siblings' 1917-18 death records also misname their father), so this is very likely Thomas's death, but it is not yet proven.
* His place of origin in Ireland is not yet known. Online trees giving a birth on 15 March 1840 at Ballymacelligott, Kerry cite no source.
